description: Source code for HeadlessWindowCapturer class handling video capture and frame processing in a headless Firefox environment.

classes.name: HeadlessWindowCapturer
classes.description: Handles video frame capturing from a headless widget, including callback registration, frame processing, and format conversion.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create a scoped reference to a VideoCaptureModuleEx for a given HeadlessWidget.

methods.name: RegisterCaptureDataCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback to receive video frames.

methods.name: DeRegisterCaptureDataCallback
methods.description: Removes a previously registered video frame callback.

methods.name: RegisterRawFrameCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback for raw frame data.

methods.name: NotifyFrameCaptured
methods.description: Notifies all registered callbacks of a captured frame.

methods.name: StopCaptureIfAllClientsClose
methods.description: Stops capture if no callbacks are registered.

methods.name: StartCapture
methods.description: Starts capturing frames, setting a snapshot listener on the window.
